pageProps.markdownHtml:
Info: Machine translation This post was machine-translated from the Chinese original. Wording may be rough in places — the Chinese version is authoritative.

Summary First, look at the original image, then choose password-free, periodic quota, or trial points HyphenTech · Data and measurements from November 2, 2026

The free drawing entry offers public services that don’t require keys, interfaces generated by registration based on quota, and ways to earn points by completing tasks. This article breaks down the image solutions already collected. First, we show two actual outputs: both want the robot to water the water, one drew the main subject correctly, the other returned the person.

Agnes chose agnes-image-2.5-flash, 1K, 16:9, received 1312×736 PNGs, with a full upstream request of 15.688 seconds. Pollinations Classic received 768×768 JPEGs, but the content did not match the robot’s watering task. The fact that the second image can be opened does not mean the task is complete.

First, let’s look at the completed Agnes text-to-text image

By default, the trial file currently offers limited exemption for specified Flash image model stages. Agent Plan converts points based on the publication price, and cannot directly apply zero price. Before this call, the instant zero price was confirmed and payment rollback was prohibited; The final bill was not read. Complete connection method, parameters, and original image checks are in the Agnes test section.

Official entry: Image interface documentation; Pricing and trial rules.

Other drawing entries are selected separately according to free sources

CogView-3-Flash Free Drawing (To Be Tested)

**Cycle free / designated zero price. **Official pricing list lists it as free; No unified limit on the number of rides is available this period.

Requires your own key; Check the current model’s open state, rate limit, and resolution.

Model recorded in this edition: cogview-3-flash.

https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

Modai API-Inference (to be tested)

**Periods are free / designated zero price. **Official offers free inference; The historical official announcement states 2,000 times per day; the current modal limit page is a dynamic page, so the full amount was not obtained this issue.

Use your own access token, and only select models with API-Inference services; Having a model repository does not mean the interface is open.

This item includes both text and images. This article only includes it in the drawing catalog and does not produce image results.

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

Cloudflare Graphics (To Be Tested)

**Free cycles / designated zero price. **Share 10,000 Neurons daily; Not 10,000 times, nor 10,000 tokens.

Multi-modal consumption under the same account; Workers Free over-limit stopped, Workers Paid over-billing; Some cutting-edge models may require additional prepayment.

The models recorded in this edition: @cf/Lykon/Dreamshaper-8-LCM.

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

Pollinations Classic illustration

**No password, data limit. **No registration required; Serial IP with at least 45-second intervals between images; Maximum area is 768×768, JPEG with a small logo.

Content may be filtered; Suitable for lightweight prototypes, not suitable for stable mass production services.

Test progress: 768×768 images have been returned, but the subject does not match the task.

https://image.pollinations.ai

Official portal: View Information.

Pollinations task points plotting (to be tested)

**Tasks/contributions can be exchanged for points. **Completing tasks earns Pollen; Redemption limits depend on the task; the purchase price of points is not free.

Requires your own Key; Only select models with the current model directory paid_only=false and the account’s free balance can be deducted.

https://gen.pollinations.ai

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

AI Horde Volunteer Shared Queue (to be tested)

**Community shared queues. **Volunteers share computing power, free text and image tasks; Queues and priorities vary with supply.

Use officially public APIs; Contributions and kudos influence priority; No commitment to fixed wait times or commercial licenses.

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

Stability API Newcomer Points (to be tested)

**One-time new employee trial. **25 free credits; 1 credit = $0.01.

One-time trial; Whether specific images or Stable Audio models can be deducted, consumption and permissions must be confirmed item by item.

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

WaveSpeed Image and Video Trial (to be tested)

**One-time trial for new users. **Eligible new accounts receive $1 free credit, no credit card required.

Some high-priced models do not allow trial points; The amount generated depends on the model, duration, and clarity.

Official portal: View Information.

The image interface and chat interface should be connected separately

Image-based response means giving existing images to the model to understand; text-to-image generates new images; The latter may also use asynchronous tasks. The platform supports image uploads and cannot directly release free drawing options. When connected to HyphenBox, text, images, and videos each register capability and test status; a single “available” switch cannot enclose everything.

First, download the original file of the generated result and check the format, size, task object, and actions; Only use the temporary URL for collection; if the link fails, you won’t even see the sample images. Services that need to queue must also save the task number, then check the original task later to avoid submitting multiple images after the timeout expires.

For commercial use, check the license for the service and specific model. The free description only applies to the cost per call and cannot automatically deduce that the material can be used in all commercial scenarios. This version has not yet reviewed the commercial license item by item.

Quote: My judgment Prioritize testing with Agnes with existing original images; Password-free entry points can be used for lightweight verification, but this time Pollinations returns do not match the task and will not be included in the successful recommendation for now. For the rest, leave entry points for free types, and after completing the actual generated results, arrange detailed test sections for each.
